hero.label: Illumine Intelligence Domains™
hero.title: The intelligence that understands the organization as an integrated system.
hero.lead: Complex enterprises do not fail due to a lack of isolated indicators. They lose value when decisions made in one area generate unnoticed impacts in others.
hero.narrative: Illumine connects multiple dimensions of the organization to reveal causal relationships, hidden risks, and strategic opportunities.

architecture.label: Domain Architecture
architecture.title: 9 Intelligence Domains™
architecture.lead: Each domain represents a perspective of the organization, but intelligence emerges from the connection between them.

core.title: Executive Intelligence Core™
core.lead: The central engine for systemic processing

d1.description: Monitors the quality of strategic decisions, their fundamentals, owners, and expected impacts.

d2.tagline: The integrated financial view of the organization
d2.description: Transforms financial statements into executive intelligence. Connects Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow, Working Capital, and Profitability.
d2.highlight: What is pressuring the economic value of the organization and what decisions can alter this trajectory.

d3.tagline: The real efficiency behind the results
d3.description: Analyzes how processes, resources, and operational capacity impact financial performance. Connects productivity, costs, and bottlenecks.

d4.description: Integrates commercial information to understand revenue generation and sustainability. Analyzes portfolio, concentration, and margins.
d4.highlight: Is current growth creating value or just increasing complexity?

d5.description: Evaluates the relationship between organizational structure, productivity, and value generation. Analyzes structural costs and knowledge retention.

d6.description: Identifies financial, operational, and institutional risks before they become crises through dependency and concentration analysis.

d7.tagline: The knowledge that remains in the organization
d7.description: Transforms accumulated experience into an institutional asset. Combats institutional amnesia by preserving context and lessons learned.

d8.description: Ensures that strategy, culture, and operations remain connected through the alignment of key indicators and objectives.

d9.description: Transforms data, experiments, and results into adaptability. Analyzes strategic hypotheses and new scenarios.

system_value.label: The Value of the System
system_value.title: Intelligence is not in the domains. It is in the connections.
system_value.lead: Traditional systems analyze isolated areas. Illumine interprets the relationships between them.
system_value.conclusion: Illumine captures this chain of impact and transforms organizational complexity into executive clarity.

conclusion.title: Discover where your organization loses value before it appears in the results.
